requirement: Evaluate same-incident transfer on held-out address groups for both Coldcard and CryptoBilis.
unit: One Bitcoin source address with its fixed reference payment.
target: Documented source-cohort membership of the incident being evaluated.
cutoff: The same fourteen frozen predictors from confirmed transactions strictly before the reference block.
groups: Reuse the previously audited connected components. Keep every component intact, even when a link is mediated by another incident. Every fit uses rows of the incident under test only.
estimator: Use the fixed Gini tree of the pinned transfer protocol with balanced weights, depth 3, minimum leaf size 20 and the original seed.
imputation: Training-fold medians and the original missing-value flags; fallback zero for an entirely missing training field.
metrics: Confusion counts, precision, recall, F1, average precision and ROC-AUC, with pooled out-of-fold and individual fold results.
